findings.desc: quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:36 imports recomputeDeliveryCheckHash from ../handlers/delivery-check.js — a core module importing from the handlers layer. This violates Core/Shell layer separation (core must not depend on handlers). The smoke test circular-import guard (flow-stability-smoke.ts:2838) only checks for story-advance imports, missing this handlers/delivery-check path. recomputeDeliveryCheckHash only uses StoryStore + crypto (pure core dependencies) and should be extracted to a core/ module (e.g. core/delivery-check-hash.ts) to sever the upward dependency.

concept-cleanup: signDeliveryCheck imported from handlers/delivery-check.js (not core/delivery-check-hash.ts) in 2 task files — field-regression-cli-smoke.ts:14 and worktree-authority-smoke.ts:13 still import from the handler re-export path instead of the canonical core module created by this story. The fix that established core/delivery-check-hash.ts as single source of truth is incomplete: tasks should import signing primitives from the core layer directly.

quality-cleanup: packages/main/src/handlers/delivery-check.ts:20-22 imports DELIVERY_CHECK_SALT and recomputeDeliveryCheckHash from core/delivery-check-hash.js but neither symbol is used anywhere in the file body — only signDeliveryCheck is referenced (lines 64, 80, 142). These are dead imports left over from the refactor.
